proof.text: Use the normalized independent-universe Hom construction and the covariant exactness and signed shift declarations in lem-weil-pbc-ringed-internal-hom-exact-restriction. The cone proof in the two variables is the same finite biproduct argument, with the first variable read in the opposite triangulated category and the second variable covariantly.

title: Independent-universe exactness of ringed internal Hom
statement: For a site with independent object and morphism universes, a sheaf of commutative rings and its module derived category, derivedInternalHomOfUniverses is triangulated covariantly in the second variable and contravariantly in the first variable, with the corresponding normalized shifts.
